视为连接状态 x 与专家动作 y* 的潜变量 z，并显式建模学生的 reason-then-act 分解：pθ(z,y|x)=pθ(z|x)pθ(y|x,z)。训练数据只有 (x, π*(·|x))。\n\n关键做法是用“反向提案 + 重要性加权”的闭环来选 CoT：\n- 反向提案 q_bwd(z|x,y)：给定 (x,y) 让模型生成多条候选 CoT（相当于从动作反推理由）。\n- 用 IWAE bound（N-sample importance-weighted bound）推导训练梯度：对每个候选 z_i 计算权重 w_i = pθ(z_i,y|x) / q_bwd(z_i|x,y)，归一化后得到软权重 ~w_i，对 (z_i,y) 做加权 SFT 更新。直观上，这一步在做“E-step 式的解释选择”：保留那些能显著提高学生在给定 CoT 时预测专家动作概率 pθ(y|x,z) 的解释。\n- M-step 目标是拟合专家策略 π*：当专家给出分布时可闭式期望；只给单动作时退化为 Dirac。\n\n与直接让 LLM 写 CoT 的差别在于：LeAct 的过滤标准不是‘解释像不像’，而是‘解释是否让模型更能复现专家动作’，从而抑制 rationalization。与一些 latent-EM 自训练（如 proposal-and-score）相似，但这里 latent 被外部专家动作锚定，而不是被模型自生成文本锚定。","experiments":"论文覆盖三类专家来源：\n- CFR solver：在可枚举的小型不完全信息扑克（如 Leduc Hold’em）上，LeAct 训练的学生可以匹配专家 solver。\n- DeepCFR policy：在更大规模的 Flop Hold’em（文中提到约 10^9 infosets）上，LeAct 分配比后期更关键，这和 pretrain 中 curriculum、cooldown、compute allocation 的思路是相通的。贡献量级上，这不是改变能力上限的范式工作，而是一个相对干净、工程上可落地的效率改进：不引入额外大池采样，不依赖历史统计做滞后筛选，也不改损失函数，重点是把同样的 rollout 预算用得更有效。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 VIGOR：Variance Guided Online Rollout allocation。作者先从二值奖励情形分析 GRPO 梯度，指出组内奖励方差直接决定了梯度信号强弱。直观上，如果一个 prompt 的多条 rollout 要么全对要么全错，那么组内相对优势几乎没有区分度；只有同一 prompt 下出现对错混合，GRPO 才能从组内比较中得到有效更新。基于这个观察，VIGOR 不再给所有 prompt 一次性分配固定 G 条 rollout，而是采用逐轮细化的在线分配。流程大致是：先给每个 prompt 一个较小的初始 rollout 数；根据当前已采样结果估计组级 reward variance；挑出方差最高、最可能继续产生信息增益的 prompt；再只对这些 prompt 追加 rollout；重复若干轮直到达到总预算。这样做和 DAPO 一类方法的区别在于，VIGOR 不是先为所有样本生成更大的候选池再过滤，而是在生成过程中边看信号边追加预算，因此避免了“为了筛选而额外生成”的开销。和利用 stale rollout 或辅助目标的方法相比，它也不改训练目标，仍然是标准 GRPO，只改 rollout allocation。文中还给出一个理论分析：在 Pareto 分布假设下，随着 refinement rounds 增加，相对标准 GRPO 的速度收益可以闭式刻画，并呈指数式增长趋势。这个理论更多是说明自适应分配在重尾信息分布下为什么有效，而不是严格预测真实训练曲线。","experiments":"实验覆盖数学推理和代码两类 RLVR 任务。数学部分使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B、3B、7B 和 Phi-4-Mini-Instruct，在 6 个 benchmark 上比较 rollout efficiency 和最终精度。结论比较稳定：在达到相同准确率时，VIGOR 需要更少 rollout；其中在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，rollout efficiency 最多提升 2.3 倍。若按公平的 rollout-matched 设置比较，也就是总 rollout 数相同，VIGOR 在四个模型设定上都拿到更高的平均分。代码部分在 LiveCodeBench v6 上用 Qwen3-8B，VIGOR 用 1.49 倍更少的 rollout 达到 GRPO 的最终 full pass rate，同时平均 test pass rate 还提升 3.4 个点。论文的关键说服力不只是最终分数，而是训练曲线：早期阶段同样预算下爬升更快，说明它确实把算力集中到了更有学习价值的样本上。值得注意的是，这类方法的收益通常依赖 reward variance 的长尾程度；如果任务本身大多数 prompt budget 的曲线，另一类是 rollout-matched 的最终结果表。前者回答“是否更省”，后者回答“同预算是否更强”。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够把核心思想和实验结论读清。若想深挖，可重点想两个问题：一是 reward variance 作为信息量代理在非二值、带格式奖励或代码单元测试奖励下是否仍然稳健；二是这种在线 allocation 能否和异步 RL、prompt-level curriculum 或 verifier uncertainty 结合。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper targets a specific inefficiency in RLVR with GRPO: a fixed number of rollouts is GRPO 的重采样变体。对每个 prompt，先从旧策略过采样 K 条候选 response，而不是直接用 M 条 response 更新。然后按正确性分成正样本和负样本，并保留过采样池中的经验正确/错误比例：N+(x)=round(M·N~+(x)/K)，N−(x)=M−N+(x)。接着在每个正确性类别内部按长度划分 short 和 long，再用 quadrant-weighted sampling 选择最终训练组。策略是偏向采样 short correct 和 long incorrect。原因是，在 GRPO 中正确样本通常获得正 advantage，会被强化；因此强化短且正确的轨迹会鼓励简洁解法。错误样本通常获得负 advantage，会被压低；选择长且错误的轨迹，相当于把“冗长但失败”的模式作为负梯度来源。它不修改 reward、advantage estimator 或后续 GRPO 更新流程。相比只选最短 response 的过滤方法，QLPO 保留了负样本的梯度作用，也减少了因为改变正负比例而扭曲 group-relative advantage 的风险。","experiments":"作者报告在 1.5B 到 32B 参数规模、base model 和已有 reasoning model 上做了实验，任务覆盖数学和科学类 benchmark。主要结论是 token，带来线性增长的时延、KV-cache 和服务成本；但已有证据表明，中间推理链的“正确性”与最终答案正确性并不稳定同因，推理链长度也不可靠地对应题目复杂度。于是问题变成：能不能把这些由显式 CoT 承载的计算，蒸馏进学生模型参数里，让模型少想甚至不显式想，也能保住答案质量？论文进一步追问两个更难的问题：第一，完全去掉中间 token 后，性能损失到底有多大，是否依任务而异；第二，若完全内化做不到，保留一部分后缀式 scaffold 是否能在成本和性能之间形成更平滑的折中，尤其是在 OOD 条件下是否更稳。","importance":"对预训练/后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值不在于又提出一个“短推理”技巧，而在于把一个更根本的问题摆到台面上：显式 reasoning token 到底是训练时的脚手架，还是推理时不可替代的计算介质。论文给出的答案不是一刀切。它显示，CoT 的可内化程度强烈依赖任务类型与分布外泛化要求：在较封闭、可枚举结构更强的任务上，蒸馏学生可以吃下相当一部分教师推理信息；但在更难的数学 OOD 设置上，完全去掉显式推理会明显掉点，而保留部分 scaffold 能恢复不少性能。这对做 RL reasoning、test-time compute、latent reasoning、implicit CoT 的人都很重要，因为它把“是否需要显式 token”从口号问题变成了可测的 trade-off 问题。另一个实际意义是，论文比较了 masked distillation 与直接用 teacher rollout 做 SFT 的差异，说明训练目标本身会影响学生是否真的学到‘压缩后的内部计算’，而不是只学到答案分布。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 masked distillation。训练时，教师处于 thinking mode，看到问题 q 和完整推理链 r 以及答案 a；学生只看到问题 q，不看到中间推理 token，但要生成答案 token。关键不是简单做 hard-label SFT，而是让教师在给定 q+r 的条件下，对学生生成的答案 token 提供逐 token 的监督信号。也就是说，学生学习的是“在缺失 CoT 条件下，去匹配教师在拥有 CoT 时对答案分布的判断”。这比直接模仿 teacher rollout 更像一种条件不对称蒸馏：教师拥有额外上下文，学生被迫把这部分信息压进参数。\n\n论文给了两个实例化版本。第一是 self-distillation：同一个模型既当会思考的教师，也当不思考的学生，重点看同架构下能否把显式推理压回参数。第二是 dual-model distillation：用 reasoning model 去监督另一个 non-thinking student，更接近实际部署里“强教师+便宜学生”的设定。\n\n另一个关键设计是 α-suffix masked distillation。作者不把“有 CoT/无 CoT”当成二元选择，而是把教师推理链分成前缀和后缀。学生在训练时内化前面的 (1-α) 部分，只在推理时显式生成后面的 α 部分 scaffold，再输出答案。α=0 表示完全不显式推理，只答答案；α=1 则接近完整显式推理。这个设计很有研究味道，因为它把“推理 token 的作用”拆成了可量化的连续变量，能直接测性能-成本曲线。\n\n从全文看，作者还专门比较了不同训练目标。一个重要对照是：如果直接拿 teacher 的完整 rollout 做监督微调，让学生学着输出答案甚至部分推理，是否能达到 masked distillation 的效果。论文的结论倾向于否定简单 SFT 替代，因为 masked distillation 的重点是让学生在缺失中间 token 的条件下对齐教师的答案分布，而不是复现教师表面轨迹。这个差别决定了学生学到的是“轨迹模仿”还是“轨迹压缩”。","experiments":"实验覆盖两个域：Math 和 Countdown，并显式区分 ID 与 OOD。Math 里用 GSM8K 作为主训练/测试域，MATH-500 与 AIME-25 作为更难的 OOD；Countdown 则设计 target-range shift 和 Yet prior evidence suggests that trace correctness is not tightly causally tied to final-answer correctness, and trace length is not a reliable proxy for instance complexity. The real question is therefore whether the information carried by explicit reasoning tokens can be internalized into model parameters, so that a student can answer directly, or with much shorter scaffolds, without losing too much capability. optimization，而不是把所有约束揉进一个统一损失里。作者先把约束分成两类：soft constraints 是主观、偏好型、难以程序验证的要求，比如语气、风格、鼓励性表达；hard constraints 是客观、可规则检查的要求，比如输出 JSON、包含指定字段、满足字数/格式/语言/枚举条件等。\n\nStage 1 用 preference optimization 去学 soft constraints，而且不是传统一对一 chosen/rejected，而是为同一条复杂指令构造多个负样本。这样做的理由很直接：复杂指令里常见的失败不是“完全错”，而是漏掉某一条约束、部分满足、风格偏差、格式轻微违规。多负样本能让模型看到更细粒度的错误形态，提升对软约束差异的辨别力。摘要和正文都提到这一阶段使用 multiple negative samples 来 sharpen sensitivity。\n\nStage 2 用 RLVR，具体实现是 GRPO，在有 verifier 的硬约束上直接做强化学习。这里的关键不是再训练一个 reward model，而是利用规则验证器给出确定性奖励，避免整体偏好目标把硬约束信号稀释掉。对于复杂 instruction following，这种设计是合理的，因为很多失败模式是离散的、可判定的，适合 binary 或 scalar verifier。\n\n数据侧，作者提出自动化复杂约束合成框架，并构建 StaInstruct。数据构造不是简单拼接约束，而是显式建模 task-constraint compatibility，过滤无效、冗余、冲突约束。每条样本包含复杂指令、正样本回答、多个针对 soft constraints 的负样本，以及针对 hard constraints 的规则验证代码。这个数据结构正好支撑两阶段训练：第一阶段吃 preference triples / listwise negatives，第二阶段吃 verifier reward。\n\n和常见 DPO 或单阶段 RL 相比，StaIF 的区别不在公式多新，而在训练信号分解得更贴近任务结构。作者的主张是：如果把软硬约束混在一个 holistic objective StaIF 训练后的 Tulu3-8B-SFT 在 IFEval 和 IFBench 上能接近一些更大闭源模型的水平。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格，这里不编造具体分数，但可以确认几个实验重点。\n\n第一，主结果证明两阶段训练优于只做单阶段偏好优化或其他基线，且提升覆盖多个 benchmark，而不是只在一个数据集上有效。第二，ablation 显示两个阶段都有效：只做 Stage 1 会改善软约束相关表现，但对严格可验证约束不够；加入 Stage 2 后，hard constraint compliance 进一步提高。第三，多负样本设计是有效的。作者专门做了 negative sampling 的实验，说明多个负样本比单个 rejected response 提供更强的对比学习信号。第四，作者强调泛化而非记忆，说明他们做了更细粒度分析，检查模型是否只是记住训练模板，还是能迁移到新的约束组合。\n\n如果从研究角度看，最值得留意的不是 benchmark 排名，而是约束类型拆分后的误差分析：哪些约束在 DPO 下容易被忽略，哪些约束在 verifier RL 下最容易被拉起来，以及 bilingual 数据是否让中文复杂指令跟随能力有额外收益。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议按“问题定义—数据—两阶段训练—消融”这个顺序看。\n\n先看 Introduction，重点理解作者为什么坚持把 soft / hard constraints 分开。若这一点不认同，后面的设计就很难成立。\n\n然后看 StaInstruct 数据构造部分。这里比方法公式更重要，因为复杂 paper targets a specific failure mode in complex instruction following: when an instruction contains multiple constraints, existing alignment methods often optimize a single holistic preference signal, which blurs together heterogeneous requirements. As a result, models may improve in overall helpfulness while still failing strict must-satisfy constraints such as format, structure, counting, language, or valid JSON. The question is whether one can separate the optimization of subjective soft constraints from objectively verifiable hard constraints, so that the model learns both nuanced preference alignment and strict per-constraint compliance, especially under multi-constraint and out-of-distribution combinations.","importance":"This is not a core pretraining paper; it is better viewed as a post-training and alignment paper, so skim is the right level. We study a minimal alternative based on a simple API-level control: allowing users to bias the model's logits with a user-defined vector. We develop a black-box method for","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-24T18:27:58Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2607_22837.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作研究一个很受限但现实的问题：当模型只能通过 的，而作者研究的是一个极弱的近似族——context-independent 的固定 logit bias，进而分析这种近似什么时候有效、误差来自哪里、如何在黑盒条件下估计和学习。","importance":"对基座预训练本身，它不是直接改进训练 recipe 的论文，但对 pretrain 和 deployment 接口有明确启发。第一，它把“解码侧控制”形式化成一个可分析的策略类，而不是经验性的 prompt trick，这对理解模型输出分布中哪些偏差是全局 token 级、哪些必须依赖上下文，很有帮助。第二，它给出一个很低成本的适配基线：不改权重、不占上下文、不需要 provider 训练权限，适合拿来和 prompt、LoRA、black-box RL πδ(yt|x,y<t)=softmax(l(x,y<t)+δ)。因为 δ 与上下文无关，它只能做全局 token 偏置重排，不能表达 prefix-specific 决策。理论部分从 KL-regularized RL 出发：给定终局 reward r(x,y1:T)，若允许任意策略，最优解可写成对 base policy 的指数倾斜，等价于按软 Q / advantage 做 prefix-dependent 的 logit 修正。作者随后把固定 δ 看成对这一最优修正的投影近似，给出 reward gap 的上界，误差项由“真实最优修正随 prefix 变化的程度”决定。直观上，如果某个任务的最优修正主要表现为稳定的 token 级偏好，比如更偏向 EOS、特定格式 token、简洁回答常见收尾词，那么固定 δ 就能逼近得不错；如果修正强依赖局部语境，它就会失效。\n\n学习上，作者推导了一个闭式的 IPS 风格估计器。数据来自 base model 或当前策略的 rollout，配合序列级 reward 和每步 token 概率，就能构造对目标的无偏或近似无偏估计，而不需要反传到模型内部。实现上可以理解为：统计高回报轨迹中哪些 token 在全局上被系统性高估或低估，再把这种差异压缩成一个共享 bias。论文还讨论了 full-vocabulary bias 与稀疏/受限 bias 的差别，结论是全词表参数化虽然简单，但比只调少量 token 更稳，因为很多行为修正依赖一组相关 token 的协同重排，而不是单个关键词。与 prompt optimization 相比，它不消耗上下文，也不要求模型遵循显式自然语言指令；与 PEFT/微调相比，它几乎没有训练和部署侵入性；与一般 black-box RL 相比，它把策略空间限制得很小，因此样本效率和稳定性更可控，但上限也更低。","experiments":"实验部分主要验证三件事。第一，固定 logit bias 是否真能带来可测的任务收益。作者在数学与推理类基准上做了黑盒适配，结果显示，相比原始 base model，full-vocabulary logit bias 能带来稳定提升，同时训练参数量远小于常规微调。第二，这种方法在哪些任务上更有效。全文的现象是：当目标行为带有明显的全局 token 偏置特征时，收益更明显，例如控制冗长度、输出格式、结束倾向，或在小分布偏移上修正常见答案模式；而需要细粒度条件决策的任务，提升有限。第三，理论预测是否和经验一致。消融表明，full-vocabulary 版本优于受限 token 子集；KL 正则和 IPS 估计对稳定训练有帮助；reward 设计若更接近 verifiable reward，学习信号更干净。\n\n从你给出的全文片段里，能确认作者主要使用 RLVR 风格设定，即每个 prompt 有可验证答案，reward 由生成结果是否正确等规则给出。引言明确声称在数学和推理 benchmark 上优于 base model，并且使用“far fewer trainable parameters In standard KL-regularized RL, β controls the trade-off between improving task reward and staying close to a reference policy, but the objective itself does not say what β should be. In practice, people use manual sweeps, target-KL heuristics, or adaptive controllers. The paper reframes this as a sequential detection game: an agent wants to increase reward by deviating from the reference policy, while a monitor observes outputs and tries to detect whether the deployed policy is still the reference one. Once deviation is detected, deployment stops. Under this view, β becomes the equilibrium price of statistical detectability rather than a free hyperparameter.","importance":"Its main value is conceptual, but not merely philosophical. It gives KL-regularized RL an operational interpretation that is directly relevant to post-training of pretrained models: preserving the reference model is equivalent to staying near the edge of detectability under sequential monitoring. That matters for RLHF, RLVR, continual learning, and model auditing, where policy drift is often the real concern. The contribution is not a new training objective replacing current pipelines; instead, it explains why the existing objective appears in practice and provides a principled way to choose β. For pretrain–posttrain interface work, this is useful because it turns reward-retention into a game-theoretic equilibrium problem rather than a pure hyperparameter search problem.","technical_approach":"$a7","experiments":"The experiments cover two settings. In continual learning, using Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-1B, the equilibrium-derived β gives a better reward-retention trade-off than compute-matched manual tuning. The paper is careful and describes this as preliminary evidence, which is appropriate: the empirical section is there to validate the framework, not to claim broad benchmark dominance. In model auditing, the monitor uses the equilibrium-prescribed sequential test to detect hidden model modifications by API providers. The method detects changes faster than natural baselines while controlling type-I error. For a reader interested in training methodology, the important empirical takeaways are not the absolute scores but two qualitative findings: the equilibrium β can replace part of manual hyperparameter search, and the detectability view leads to a practical auditing procedure with measurable gains in detection delay.","reading_guide":"Start with the introduction and problem setup. The DecodeShare protocol offers a reproducible empirical foundation for future work on reliable model behavior intervention, inference-time alignment, and mechanistic interpretability of multi-task computation in LLMs.","technical_approach":"The work first formalizes the distinction between two types of hidden states: prefill hidden states sampled at the final prompt position, and decode-time decision states: the per-token hidden states computed at each KV-cached decode step that directly produce next-token logits. The DecodeShare protocol runs in two stages. First, it collects decode-time hidden states across a diverse set of tasks, and extracts a consistent low-dimensional shared subspace via PCA. Second, it runs controlled causal ablation interventions that only remove projection onto this subspace during decode steps, leaving prefill computation completely unmodified, with matched baselines using prefill-derived subspaces and random subspaces of equal dimension. The work further measures overlap between this shared decode subspace and widely used activation steering directions, and compares the predictive power of decode-time versus prefill-time evaluation for ranking steering vector utility under realistic KV-cached inference.","experiments":"Across multiple open-source LLMs and task benchmarks: 1) Under matched intervention dimension budgets, removing the decode-shared subspace causes several times larger accuracy degradation than removing prefill-derived or random subspaces of the same size, confirming the high causal leverage of this subspace for decode decisions. 2) Common activation steering directions exhibit significant overlap with the shared decode subspace; projecting out this overlap does not produce universal steering robustness improvements, but instead introduces task-dependent utility-robustness tradeoffs. 3) Ranking steering vectors based on decode-time evaluation produces significantly better predictions of held-out KV-cached decoding performance than rankings derived from prefill states.","reading_guide":"Focus on the formal definition of prefill vs decode states in the methodology section, the DecodeShare pipeline design, the matched causal intervention logic, and ablation results on steering vector overlap. The effective epistemic dimensionality of a single LLM's sampling distribution has never been rigorously quantified.","importance":"This work demonstrates that stochastic sampling within a single model injects largely independent noise, rather than the structured uncertainty representation found in multi-model ensembles. Only \"borderline questions\" (those with pass rates between 5% and 95%) are retained for analysis, and the number of eigenvalues of the correlation matrix that exceed the Marchenko–Pastur noise upper edge is counted as a measure of structured epistemic dimensionality.","experiments":"Three key results are reported: First, across five LLM families (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3-8B) and three benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K chain-of-thought), at most one eigenvalue within a single model touches the Marchenko–Pastur noise edge, and all fall within Tracy–Widom sampling noise with no statistical significance — meaning within-model sampling variation has no detectable cross-question structured correlation, and per-question correctness fluctuations are approximately independent. Second, an ensemble of 24 diverse models shows four above-noise eigenvalues on MMLU, which cannot be explained by a matched-difficulty Bernoulli null, confirming significantly higher epistemic dimensionality across models. Third, the conclusion holds across temperatures from 0.5 to 1.5, and is validated by parallel analysis and effective rank metrics.","reading_guide":"For a skim read, focus on Section 2 (method design: core logic of the Marchenko–Pastur test, rationale for borderline question filtering) and Section 3 (core results on within-model dimensionality ceiling and cross-model comparison). The formulation distinguishes exogenous turns, model-generated assistant turns, and tool-result turns. Attribution is computed at the token level, then aggregated to sentence or turn-level units for graph construction and path extraction. The main design choice is to reuse existing attribution methods inside a recursive graph-building procedure, rather than train a specialized explainer. The D-Score is a relative numerical-rank statistic: it counts how many singular directions remain sufficiently close to the leading direction under a chosen tolerance. A larger D-Score means that the hidden trajectory spreads its energy over more comparable directions. The motivation is that supported text should induce a more coherent trajectory, while unsupported or internally conflicting claims introduce additional directions associated with uncertainty or contradiction. The detector uses a calibrated tolerance and a decision threshold, and predicts hallucination when the D-Score exceeds that threshold. Computationally, a full singular decomposition is not required; leading singular values can be estimated until the relative cutoff is reached.","experiments":"The experiments are reported on Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Vicuna-7B across multiple hallucination benchmarks. That matters for multilingual data mixture design, shared tokenization, low-resource language scaling, and representation evaluation. discussion。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper asks a more precise question than whether language has long-range dependence. It isolates how much predictive benefit comes from word order itself, after controlling for the presence of the same words and broad topical content, and studies how that benefit decays with distance. Prior regularities such as Zipf, Heaps, or long-range mutual information either ignore order or only capture pairwise co-occurrence. Here the authors define a contextual persistence function (CPF) using LLMs as probabilistic probes: as more distant context is revealed, how much does target surprisal drop with the intact sequence, beyond the drop obtained from the same revealed words in scrambled order? The core problem is therefore to quantify the distance law of order-specific contextual influence in natural language.","importance":"Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it gives a cleaner decomposition of why long context helps: some of the gain is not just more lexical evidence, but specifically ordered structure that remains useful far away and decays roughly as 1/d. Second, it introduces a measurement that separates arrangement-sensitive signal from lexical/topic signal, which is relevant for analyzing what autoregressive LMs actually exploit, whether long-context architectures preserve order information, and how alternative objectives might differ. Third, it is methodologically interesting as a scaling-law-style result about language itself rather than about loss versus compute. Using LLMs as measurement instruments to estimate a linguistic law could be useful for comparing tokenizers, memory mechanisms, masked or any-order objectives, and long-context training recipes. The contribution is best read as a new empirical law plus a probing framework, not as a direct training method.","technical_approach":"$c6","experiments":"$c7","reading_guide":"Start with the definition. The key is to understand exactly what intact versus scrambled controls for, and what it does not. Then read the main result figures showing log-log CPF curves, exponent fits, and the distribution across languages and corpora. After that, spend time on the control sections: random or synthetic sequences, partial order corruption, and analyses of whether the signal is sentence-local or broadly spread.\n\nTwo questions are worth keeping in mind. First, does scrambling remove only order, or does it also create a distribution shift that changes model calibration in other ways? prompt 相对 neutral prompt 对 next-token distribution 的影响。具体地，对同一个生成历史 h 和 token v，计算 u_r,θ(h,v)=log pθ(v|h,s_r)-log pθ(v|h,s_0)。这个 log-ratio 表示 role prompt 如何重新加权模型的默认预测：正值说明角色提示提高该 token 概率，负值说明压低该 token 概率。Role Drift 被定义为 RL 过程中这个 role utility 偏离 pre-RL 值。Role Anchor 在 policy gradient 目标中加入正则，约束当前 role utility 不要远离训练前的 role utility。它不改系统架构，也不需要为每个模块人工标注细粒度行为标签。和普通 KL 不同，它锚定的是“role prompt 相对 neutral prompt 的差异”，因此保留的是角色提示带来的行为方向，而不是简单限制整个策略不更新。作者还用梯度分析说明，Role Anchor 主要是把更新从角色违规方向上拉开，而不是整体压制学习。","experiments":"实验覆盖两个复合系统。第一个是多跳推理中的 Decomposer-Solver pipeline。Decomposer compound LLM systems: after end-to-end RL, the final answer accuracy can improve while individual modules stop following their intended roles. A decomposer may leak answer entities, and a reader may ignore retrieved evidence and rely on parametric memory.","importance":"The main contribution is a clean diagnosis of a training-signal mismatch in outcome-only RL. A terminal reward constrains the final answer, but it does not constrain where the computation happens inside a modular system. This matters for systems whose value comes from grounding, auditability, parallelism, or module replaceability. The paper gives a measurable notion of drift and a lightweight regularizer, making it useful as a practical tool for RL training of compound LLM systems.","technical_approach":"The proposed method, Role Anchor, defines a module’s role through the effect of its role prompt relative to a neutral prompt. For the same history h and token v, the role utility is u_r,θ(h,v)=log pθ(v|h,s_r)-log pθ(v|h,s_0). This log-ratio measures how the role prompt reweights the module’s default next-token distribution. Role drift is then a change in this utility during end-to-end optimization. Role Anchor adds a regularization term to the policy-gradient objective to keep the current role utility close to its pre-RL value. This differs from a standard KL constraint: it anchors the effect of the role prompt, not the whole policy distribution. Since direct joint optimization is expensive and rewards are sparse, the method alternates between harness optimization and model optimization. With the model fixed, the system collects rollouts and sends failed trajectories to an LLM-based HarnessCritic. The critic attributes failures to structured harness-level causes, such as prompt ambiguity, tool-schema mismatch, missing skills, or middleware problems, and proposes local diffs. segment","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-25T21:01:14Z","category_id":"pretraining_data","cover_url":"/covers/2607_23362.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但长期被启发式方法主导的问题：当部署时采用 WordPiece 常见的 greedy left-to-right longest-match（GL2R）解码规则时，怎样直接为这个推理规则学习词表，而不是像 BPE 那样先用贪心 merge 过程构造词表，再把它拿去给另一套推理规则使用。难点不在“压缩目标”本身，而在“词表选择”和“分词可实现性”是耦合的：某个切分方案只有在不存在更长 token 抢占边界时，才真能被 GL2R 解码复现。论文要解决的核心，就是把这种 greedy 一致性精确写进优化问题里，使训练时优化的 token 数与部署时真实产生的 token 数一致。","importance":"对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一层是 tokenizer 设计范式：词表训练不必绑定某个历史启发式，而应当围绕部署时的 inference rule 直接建模。JOLT 把“tokenizer byte-level、固定词表规模、固定贪心最长匹配规则的设定下，单靠更强的词表优化，剩余空间并不大。对做大模型预训练的人来说，这个结论比单纯“又快了 0.x%”更重要，因为它帮助判断 tokenizer 研究的边际收益在哪里。","technical_approach":"方法上，JOLT 延续了 ToaST 和 ConvexTok 的“整数规划 → 线性松弛 → rounding”路线，但关键区别是它不是为 split-tree 或 shortest-path 推理设计，而是专门为 GL2R 设计约束。建模对象有两类变量：一类表示候选 token 是否进入词表，另一类表示每个 pretoken 选用哪一种候选 segmentation。目标函数是最小化按频次加权的总 token 数，也就是压缩目标。真正的技术核心在 greedy-consistency constraints：如果某个 pretoken 选择了一个 segmentation，那么在每个 segment 起点处，不能存在一个更长、且同样匹配该位置字节串的已选 token，否则 GL2R 实际会优先输出那个更长 token，训练时选的 segmentation 就不可实现。这个约束把“分词方案”和“词表内容”紧密耦合起来。\n\n另一个关键点是规模控制。因为一个长度为 n 的 pretoken 有 2^(n-1) 种切分，不能全部显式枚举。JOLT 采用按需生成候选 segmentation 的做法，先只保留少量低阶切分，再在求解过程中逐步加入需要的候选，避免组合爆炸。训练语料先按 regex 切成 pretoken，并聚合相同 pretokens 的频次；实际优化只保留 top-N 高频 pretokens。求解时先做 LP relaxation，再通过 rounding 得到固定大小词表。论文强调 rounding 不是主要误差来源，因为最终离 LP bound 很近。和 BPE 相比，JOLT 不再依赖局部 merge 频次；和 UnigramLM 相比，它不是概率生成式分词；和 ConvexTok/ToaST 相比，它的可行性条件是由 GL2R 的最长匹配机制决定的，而不是最短路或树结构推理。","experiments":"实验重点不是下游任务，而是压缩质量、LP 下界诊断和 rounding 损失。作者在四个训练 scope 上评估，N 取 100k、200k、300k、400k 高频 pretokens。结果是：在相同词表规模下，JOLT 在 held-out 文本上的 greedy-L2R token count 相对 BPE 最多下降 0.78%，而且更大的训练 scope 一般带来持平或更好的压缩。更有信息量的是下界分析：BPE 在训练 scope 上距离 LP lower bound 只有 1%–2%，说明 BPE 在 GL2R 设定下已经相当接近最优；JOLT 能弥合其中 89.6%–99.4% 的 gap；rounding 后的离散词表距离 LP bound 仅
